scores.tell: Cap crown slightly puffy and soft; brim is smooth, but proportions and thin gold band are fine.
The AC unit's body is a soft pillow with a very rounded end cap. Airflow streams are the fuzzy bits.
Chair is toy-like: tubes thick and sausage-like, armrests puffy, feet fat orange blobs, seat sagging.
Chest has crisp planar faces and tight gold corner bevels; the lid dome is fine. Minor: heap of coins is chunky.
Lectern has flat planar faces and straight edges, but the shape is very symmetric and stiff. The thin mic arm is fine.
none; the hat has a clean silhouette, a smooth cone and a tight buckle, in the same style as the real towel and saddle.
Slide tube is thick and swollen, but ladder rails and posts stay thin. Lofty pool edge is soft.
Claw machine is a fat rounded block with very soft corners; the cabinet is pillowy and the chunky tray. Pastel toy look.
Wagon matches the real one: planar bed, thin spokes and a straight shaft. The cover is a touch lumpy and the wheel rim is thick.
Broom handle is thin and straight and the bristles are tapered. The head is slightly fat, but fine.
